scripts.dev: npm run dev:mysql && npm run dev:preflight && node scripts/dev-stack.mjs
scripts.dev:tunnel: npm run dev:mysql && npm run dev:preflight && node scripts/dev-stack.mjs --tunnel
scripts.demo: npm run dev:mysql && npm run dev:preflight && node scripts/dev-stack.mjs --tunnel --warm-recovery
scripts.lint:backend: eslint backend/api/src backend/api/scripts backend/api/tests frontend/src/services shared/contracts.ts
scripts.format:backend: prettier --check --end-of-line auto backend/api/src backend/api/scripts backend/api/tests frontend/src/services shared/contracts.ts backend/firebase.json backend/firebase.test.json
scripts.check:backend: npm run build:backend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:backend && npm run format:backend
scripts.test:backend:reset-db: cd backend/api && cross-env NODE_ENV=test MYSQL_DATABASE=petconnect_test tsx scripts/reset-test-db.ts
scripts.test:backend:run: cd backend/api && cross-env NODE_ENV=test MYSQL_DATABASE=petconnect_test tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/config.test.ts tests/finder-otp-delivery.test.ts tests/uploads.test.ts tests/media-storage.test.ts tests/media-cleanup.test.ts tests/care-calendar.test.ts tests/migrations.test.ts tests/recovery-match.test.ts tests/backend.test.ts
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:backend && npm run test:backend:reset-db && firebase --config backend/firebase.test.json emulators:exec --project demo-petconnect-test --only auth "cross-env FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-petconnect-test npm run test:backend:run"
scripts.test:frontend: node --test scripts/tests/dev-proxy.test.cjs && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.deploy:web: npm run web:export:production && firebase deploy --only hosting --project petconnect-umtc-20260929
scripts.release:static: npm run check:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:production-readiness && npm run doctor:frontend && npm run web:export
scripts.release:check: npm run audit:prod && npm run release:static && npm run test:e2e && npm run release:android && npm run release:ios
scripts.release:verify: npm run release:check && npm run test:backend
